cards.title: 词汇：教室物品
cards.definition: 学习描述教室里的常见物品的英语单词。

example.question: 看图写单词：这是一张课桌。

mistakes.correct: desk

cards.memory_tip: desk和chair是好朋友，一个用来写，一个用来坐；board是黑板，写写画画真方便。

cards.title: 句型：询问和回答物品
cards.definition: 学习用 'What's this?' 和 'What's that?' 询问物品，并用 'It's a...' 回答。
core_points: What's this? 这是什么？ (指近处的物品)
What's that? 那是什么？ (指远处的物品)
It's a [物品]. 这是一个[物品]。
It's an [物品]. 这是一个[物品]。(当物品名词以元音音素开头时)

example.question: 看图并回答：远处有一扇门。提问并回答。
steps: 确定物品是“门”且在“远处”
选择正确的疑问句 'What's that?'
example.answer: A: What's that? B: It's a door.

mistakes.correct: What's this? It's a door.
What's that? It's a desk.

cards.memory_tip: 近处用this，远处用that，回答都是 'It's a/an...'，别忘了a/an，它是小帮手。

cards.title: 自然拼读：字母Dd和Ff的发音
cards.definition: 学习字母Dd和Ff在单词中的常见发音。
core_points: Dd 发音：/d/，像中文“得”的声母。
Ff 发音：/f/，像中文“福”的声母，但需要咬下唇。

example.question: 听单词，判断包含/d/音的词：dog, fish, fan, door
steps: 在给出的单词中找出包含此音的词

mistakes.correct: 注意上下唇轻触，气流从唇缝中送出。

cards.memory_tip: D D D，小狗叫 dog；F F F，风扇 fan 呼呼转。

cards.title: 情景对话：介绍教室
cards.definition: 在教室场景中，运用所学词汇和句型进行简单的交流。
core_points: B: It's a board. And that's a window.
A: Wow, our classroom is nice!

example.question: 小明和小红在教室里，小明指着一个风扇。请你完成他们的对话。
steps: 小明问：这是什么？ (指着风扇)
小红回答：这是一个风扇。
小明赞叹：我们的教室真好！
example.answer: A: What's this? B: It's a fan. A: Our classroom is nice!

mistakes.wrong: A: Look! What's this? B: A desk.
mistakes.correct: A: Look! What's this? B: It's a desk.

cards.memory_tip: 看一看，指一指，问一问，答一答，教室里的小秘密，对话中来揭晓。

cards.title: 词汇：学习用品
cards.definition: 学习描述书包里的常见学习用品的英语单词。

example.question: 看图写单词：这是一支铅笔。

mistakes.correct: pencil

cards.memory_tip: pencil写字，pen画画，book里有故事，ruler量长短。

cards.title: 句型：询问颜色
cards.definition: 学习用 'What colour is it?' 询问物品的颜色，并用 'It's [颜色].' 回答。
core_points: What colour is it? 它是什么颜色？
常用颜色词：red, yellow, blue, green, white, black, brown, orange, purple, pink

example.question: 小明有一支红色的铅笔。请你提问并回答它的颜色。
example.answer: A: What colour is it? B: It's red.

mistakes.wrong: What colour is it? It red.
mistakes.correct: What colour is it? It's red.

cards.memory_tip: What colour is it? 红黄蓝绿我知道，颜色词儿真奇妙。

cards.title: 语法：一般疑问句 'Is this/that...?'
cards.definition: 学习用 'Is this/that...?' 提问，并用 'Yes, it is.' 或 'No, it isn't.' 回答。
core_points: 结构：Is + this/that + a/an + 名词?
否定回答：No, it isn't. (it isn't = it is not)
用于确认近处或远处的单一物品。

example.question: 老师指着一个橡皮问你：'Is this an eraser?' 你看到确实是橡皮，请你回答。

mistakes.wrong: Is this a book? Yes, it.
mistakes.correct: Is this a book? Yes, it is.

mistakes.wrong: Is that a pen? No, it not.
mistakes.correct: Is that a pen? No, it isn't.

cards.memory_tip: Is this/that开头问，Yes, it is.或No, it isn't.来回答。

cards.title: 自然拼读：字母Pp和Rr的发音
cards.definition: 学习字母Pp和Rr在单词中的常见发音。
core_points: Pp 发音：/p/，发音时双唇紧闭，然后突然张开，气流冲出。
Rr 发音：/r/，发音时舌尖卷起，不接触上颚，发出摩擦音。

example.question: 听单词，判断包含/p/音的词：rabbit, pen, ruler, pig
steps: 在给出的单词中找出包含此音的词

mistakes.correct: 注意舌尖卷起，不要接触上颚。

cards.memory_tip: P P P，铅笔 pencil 来写字；R R R，尺子 ruler 量距离。

cards.title: 词汇：身体部位
cards.definition: 学习描述身体各部位的英语单词。
core_points: eye /aɪ/ n. 眼睛 (复数 eyes)
ear /ɪər/ n. 耳朵 (复数 ears)
arm /ɑːrm/ n. 胳膊 (复数 arms)

example.question: 看图写单词：这是一只手。

mistakes.correct: feet (foot是不规则复数)

cards.memory_tip: Head and shoulders, knees and toes, knees and toes... (儿歌记忆法)

related.next: 用形容词描述身体部位

cards.title: 句型：描述身体特征
cards.definition: 学习用 'I have...' 和 'He/She has...' 描述自己或他人的身体特征。
core_points: I have [数量] [身体部位]. 我有[数量]个[身体部位]。
He/She has [数量] [身体部位]. 他/她有[数量]个[身体部位]。
例如：I have two eyes. He has a big nose.

example.question: 描述小明：他有两只大眼睛。
steps: 描述“两只大眼睛” (two big eyes)

mistakes.correct: He has two eyes.
I have a big head.

cards.memory_tip: I have，你我他她has，拥有宝贝要分清，别把have和has弄混淆。

related.prerequisite: 身体部位词汇，人称代词

cards.title: 语法：动词have/has的用法
cards.definition: 学习动词 'have' 和 'has' 表示“拥有”的用法。
core_points: 主语为 I, you, we, they 或复数名词时，用 have。
主语为 he, she, it 或单数名词时，用 has。
表示拥有、具备某种特征。
否定形式：don't have / doesn't have (四年级不强调，但可简单提及)

example.question: 选择正确的动词填空：She ____ a small mouth.
steps: 判断主语 'She' 是第三人称单数

mistakes.wrong: My friend have a long arm.
mistakes.correct: My friend has a long arm.

cards.memory_tip: I, you, we, they用have，他她它和单数用has，记住口诀不犯错。

cards.title: 情景对话：介绍朋友
cards.definition: 学习如何向他人介绍自己的朋友并简单描述其外貌特征。
core_points: A: What does he/she look like?
B: He/She has [特征]. (e.g., big eyes, short hair)
A: Oh, I see. He/She is cute/nice.

example.question: 你指着远处一个有长头发的女孩，向朋友介绍她。
example.answer: A: Who's that? B: That's my friend, Lily. A: What does she look like? B: She has long hair.

mistakes.wrong: B: That's my friend. She long hair.
mistakes.correct: B: That's my friend. She has long hair.

cards.memory_tip: Who's that? 问朋友，Has什么？看特征，介绍朋友真有趣。

cards.title: 词汇：房间和家具
cards.definition: 学习描述家里的房间和常见家具的英语单词。
core_points: living room /ˈlɪvɪŋ ruːm/ n. 客厅

example.question: 看图写单词：这是一个卧室。
steps: 图片提示：一张床的房间

mistakes.correct: living room

cards.memory_tip: Living room会客，bedroom睡觉，kitchen做饭，bathroom洗澡，study学习好地方。

cards.title: 语法：介词in, on, under表示位置
cards.definition: 学习使用介词 'in', 'on', 'under' 来描述物品的相对位置。
core_points: in: 在……里面 (The book is in the bag.)
on: 在……上面 (The apple is on the table.)
under: 在……下面 (The cat is under the chair.)
用于回答 'Where is...?' 的问题。

example.question: 选择正确的介词填空：The ruler is ____ the desk.
steps: 图片提示：尺子在桌子上面
选择表示“在上面”的介词

mistakes.wrong: The pen is in the book.
mistakes.correct: The pen is on the book.

cards.memory_tip: In里头，on上面，under在下面，小猫小狗找位置，介词来帮忙。

cards.title: 句型：询问和回答物品位置
cards.definition: 学习用 'Where's the...?' 询问物品的位置，并用 'It's in/on/under the...' 回答。
core_points: It's in/on/under the [地点]. 它在[地点]的[里面/上面/下面]。
例：Where's the ball? It's under the bed.

example.question: 看图，书在书包里。请你提问并回答书的位置。
example.answer: A: Where's the book? B: It's in the bag.

mistakes.wrong: Where's the cat? It's the chair under.
mistakes.correct: Where's the cat? It's under the chair.

cards.memory_tip: Where's the...? 问地点，in on under来回答，物品藏在哪，一问便知晓。

cards.title: 自然拼读：字母Ll和Bb的发音
cards.definition: 学习字母Ll和Bb在单词中的常见发音。
core_points: Ll 发音：/l/，发音时舌尖抵住上齿龈，气流从舌头两侧流出。
示例词：light, living room, lamp, lion
Bb 发音：/b/，发音时双唇紧闭，然后突然张开，气流冲出，声带振动。
示例词：bed, bathroom, book, bag, bird

example.question: 听单词，判断包含/b/音的词：light, bed, lamp, book
steps: 在给出的单词中找出包含此音的词

mistakes.correct: 注意舌尖位置，/l/舌尖抵住上齿龈，/r/舌尖卷起不接触。

cards.memory_tip: L L L，灯 light 亮堂堂；B B B，床 bed 睡得香。

cards.title: 词汇：家庭成员
cards.definition: 学习描述家庭成员的英语单词。

example.question: 看图写单词：这是一位母亲。

mistakes.correct: grandfather

cards.memory_tip: Father, mother, brother, sister，家庭成员一家亲，grandfather, grandmother，爱心满满乐融融。

cards.title: 句型：询问和回答年龄
cards.definition: 学习用 'How old are you?' 和 'How old is he/she?' 询问年龄，并用 'I'm.../He's.../She's...' 回答。
core_points: How old are you? 你多大了？
How old is he/she? 他/她多大了？
He's/She's [数字]. 他/她[数字]岁了。
形容词：old (年老的), young (年轻的)

example.question: 小明8岁了。请你提问并回答小明的年龄。
steps: 提问小明的年龄 (主语是he)
example.answer: A: How old is he? B: He's eight.

mistakes.wrong: How old is you? I'm eight.
mistakes.correct: How old are you? I'm eight.
He's eight. (小学阶段通常省略years old)

cards.memory_tip: How old问年龄，I'm, He's, She's来回答，数字记得要说清。

cards.title: 语法：动词be (am/is/are) 的用法
cards.definition: 学习动词be (am, is, are) 的基本用法，表示“是”或“在”。
core_points: He, She, It 或单数名词用 is (He's, She's, It's)
You, We, They 或复数名词用 are (You're, We're, They're)
常用于介绍身份、年龄、状态或位置。
否定形式：am not / isn't / aren't

example.question: 选择正确的动词填空：My father ____ tall.
steps: 判断主语 'My father' 是第三人称单数

mistakes.correct: I am a student.
They are friends.

cards.memory_tip: 我用am，你用are，is跟着他她它，复数名词都用are，be动词家族真热闹。

cards.title: 情景对话：介绍家庭成员
cards.definition: 学习如何向他人介绍自己的家庭成员。
core_points: B: Yes, he/she is. / No, he/she isn't.

example.question: 你向朋友介绍你的妈妈，她35岁，很漂亮。
example.answer: A: Who's that woman? B: That's my mother. A: How old is she? B: She's thirty-five. A: She's beautiful!

mistake.wrong: B: That's my mother. She thirty-five.
mistake.correct: B: That's my mother. She's thirty-five.

cards.memory_tip: Who's that? 问是谁，How old? 问年龄，介绍家人要清晰，be动词不忘记。

related.prerequisite: 家庭成员词汇，be动词用法，年龄句型

cards.title: 词汇：服装
cards.definition: 学习描述常见服装的英语单词。

example.question: 看图写单词：这是一件衬衫。

mistakes.correct: skirt
pants (通常用复数形式)

cards.memory_tip: T-shirt T恤，shirt衬衫，dress连衣裙，skirt小短裙，穿上新衣真高兴。

cards.title: 句型：询问和回答穿着
cards.definition: 学习用 'What are you wearing?' 询问穿着，并用 'I'm wearing...' 回答。
core_points: What are you wearing? 你穿什么？
I'm wearing a [单数衣物]. 我穿着一件[单数衣物]。
I'm wearing [复数衣物]. 我穿着[复数衣物]。
I'm wearing a [颜色] [衣物]. 我穿着一件[颜色]的[衣物]。
例：I'm wearing a red T-shirt. I'm wearing blue pants.

example.question: 小红穿着一条黄色的连衣裙。请你提问并回答她穿什么。
steps: 提问她穿什么 (主语是you，回答时变成I)
回答穿着一条黄色连衣裙
example.answer: A: What are you wearing? B: I'm wearing a yellow dress.

mistakes.correct: I'm wearing a T-shirt.
I'm wearing red pants. (pants本身是复数，不需要a/an)

cards.memory_tip: What are you wearing? 问穿什么，I'm wearing来回答，穿的什么记得说清楚。

cards.title: 自然拼读：字母组合sh和dr的发音
cards.definition: 学习字母组合sh和dr在单词中的常见发音。
core_points: sh 发音：/ʃ/，像中文“吸”的声母，嘴唇向前突出。
dr 发音：/dr/，是一个辅音连缀，发音时/d/和/r/紧密结合。

example.question: 听单词，判断包含/ʃ/音的词：dress, shoes, drink, fish
steps: 在给出的单词中找出包含此音的词

mistakes.correct: 注意嘴唇突出，发出摩擦音。

cards.memory_tip: sh sh sh，衬衫 shirt 穿身上；dr dr dr，连衣裙 dress 真漂亮。

cards.title: 情景对话：谈论穿着
cards.definition: 在日常生活中，运用所学词汇和句型谈论穿着。
core_points: A: What are you wearing today?
B: I'm wearing a blue T-shirt and white pants.
A: Oh, it's nice! What about him/her?
B: He's/She's wearing a yellow dress.

example.question: 你和朋友互相询问对方今天穿了什么。你穿了件绿色的外套，朋友穿了条红色的裙子。
steps: 朋友回答：我穿了一条红色的裙子。
你回答：我穿了一件绿色的外套。
example.answer: A: What are you wearing today? B: I'm wearing a red skirt. A: What about you? B: I'm wearing a green coat.

mistakes.wrong: A: What are you wear? B: I am a red skirt.
mistakes.correct: A: What are you wearing? B: I'm wearing a red skirt.

cards.memory_tip: 今天穿什么，问问好朋友，互相夸一夸，穿衣搭配真时尚。

related.prerequisite: 服装词汇，What are you wearing?句型
